# GeoParquet

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Load a GeoParquet file and output GeoJSON FeatureCollection via DuckDB Spatial.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/geo-parquet",
  "type": "GeoParquetOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/geo-parquet').par.url` (an input) and `op('/geo-parquet').out.featureCollection` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.url`, `out.featureCollection`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `url` | `FileUrlField` | `""` |
| `geometryColumn` | `StringField` | `"geometry"` |
| `limit` | `NumberField` | `0` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `featureCollection` | `GeoJsonField` |
| `data` | `DataField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
